title: Confirmation of the Daykin-Frankl Conjecture
summary: In 1983, Daykin and Frankl conjectured that if $P$ is a convex subset of $Q_n$, then it contains at least $|P|\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}2^{-n}$ pairwise incomparable elements. We verify and communicate an LLM-generated proof of this conjecture.
